comment: M15 tutorial day (pulled forward by P2 Part 3): one short cutscene per day part on week 1 Monday. Skipped on later runs if the player chooses.

steps.text: Monday. You overslept. Of course you overslept.

steps.speaker: parent
steps.text: You're LATE! Lunch is on the counter. Go, go, go!
Walk with the arrow keys or WASD. E talks and opens doors. The bar up top is your day: parts, Action Points, money. Go.
First class. Pick a seat, meet the teacher, try not to be memorable.
Going to class raises stats. Skipping does the opposite, slowly.
This is your schedule. Pick the week's classes; each one trains different stats. You can change it every Sunday.
The cafeteria. Kelly's table. Dex mid-bit. Theo alone with a book he isn't reading.
Talking costs AP. Some lines need Charisma, and some get misheard. Bonds grow from both.
A class event. Choices here change things later. Choose like you mean it.
After school, the town is yours. Places open and close by time of day. Gary's Deli is downtown; the forge is past the tracks.
Every action costs AP. Walking is free. When you're done, end the part.
Home. Your room has a workbench, which is a weird thing for a bedroom to have. Use it: craft your first card.
Cards you craft go straight into your deck.
